title: Last Broadcast
story: The checkout job stopped before anyone reached the dashboard. Containers can leave useful output behind even after their process exits.
objective: Read and print the recorded logs from the checkout container.
hints: docker ps -a includes containers whose process has exited.
docker logs reads output recorded for a container.
explanation: Container logs remain available after a process exits. Reading them is often the fastest first diagnostic step and does not require restarting or replacing the container.
